name: zen-mcp
description: MCP server for Zen Browser automation

scripts.build:extension: ln -sfn ../../build/extension/node_modules ../../src/extension/node_modules && trap 'rm -f ../../src/extension/node_modules' EXIT && tsc && rm -rf dist/extension && mkdir -p dist/extension && cp ../../src/extension/manifest.json ../../src/extension/background.js ../../src/extension/bridge-connection.js ../../src/extension/content-script.js ../../src/extension/network-capture.js dist/extension/ && cp -r ../../src/extension/experiment dist/extension/ && cp -r ../../src/extension/settings dist/extension/ && npx esbuild ../../src/extension/lib/index.ts --bundle --format=iife --global-name=ZenMCP --outfile=dist/extension/index.js
scripts.package: rm -f zen-mcp-*.xpi zen-mcp-*.zip && web-ext build --source-dir=dist/extension --artifacts-dir=. --overwrite-dest && mv zen-mcp-$(node -p "require('./package.json').version").zip zen-mcp-$(node -p "require('./package.json').version").xpi && mkdir -p ../../build/artifacts && cp zen-mcp-$(node -p "require('./package.json').version").xpi ../../build/artifacts/
scripts.build:all: npm run bridge:build:all && npm run build:extension && npm run package
scripts.bridge:build: npm run debug:build && mkdir -p ../../build/go-bridge/dist && cd ../../build/go-bridge/work && go build -o ../dist/zen-mcp-bridge .
